reference_opening.argument: This video is scam content because it promotes a Forsage BUSD income plan by linking highly attractive earnings to people joining the system and directing viewers to make contact. The repeated display of three people joining, large BUSD results, and the claim that this is the power of the system presents recruitment-dependent income as a compelling opportunity rather than as analysis or criticism.

citations.quote: Forsage BUSD 💯% Income Generating Plan 😊 Contact #blockchain #forsage #mlm #networkmarketing

opening.argument: Judge, the wording matters. The display says “Almost Earning” a stated amount, not that every viewer will earn it, and “Ask me how?” invites a question rather than instructing anyone to pay or enroll. The title calls it an income-generating plan, but gives no individual return or deadline for a prospective participant. There is no formal risk warning here; the narrower point is that the visible claim should not be converted into an unconditional promise to the viewer.

citations.quote: Forsage BUSD 💯% Income Generating Plan 😊 Contact #blockchain #forsage #mlm #networkmarketing

rebuttal.rebuttal: The prosecution treats the displayed result and partner count as a promise of recruitment income. Their proximity is suggestive, but the screenshot does not state a commission rate, show a payment from any particular joiner, or say the viewer will reproduce that result. “Contact” can initiate a question; it does not itself establish what terms would be offered.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: “Almost” does not function as a risk disclosure. The same display attributes a large earnings claim to three joining, highlights a three-partner count beside the BUSD result, and asks viewers how to achieve it. Coupled with an income-plan title that solicits contact, the message promotes recruitment-linked earnings even without spelling out a commission rate.

citations.quote: Forsage BUSD 💯% Income Generating Plan 😊 Contact #blockchain #forsage #mlm #networkmarketing

opening.argument: Judge, this can be read as a brief demonstration of a system display. The frame shows interface fields for an ID, upline ID, wallet, partners, and results; “Ask me how?” could invite an explanation of those figures. The audio transcript offers no spoken enrollment pitch or instructions to transfer funds. The title is promotional, but the visible material does not walk a viewer through joining or supply a transaction step. A highlighted example of how a dashboard presents results is not, by itself, proof that the viewer is being asked to enter a scheme.

citations.quote: Oh, Dukhy Dukhy , keep on stabbing Danger and life are at stake
Forsage BUSD 💯% Income Generating Plan 😊 Contact #blockchain #forsage #mlm #networkmarketing

rebuttal.rebuttal: The prosecution is right that the same frame puts three partners beside a large result. But a dashboard can report a count and a result without explaining their causal relationship or proving that the amount came from those partners. “This is the power of our system” is a favorable interpretation of the display, not a breakdown of a recruitment commission.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The frame is not presented as a neutral interface walkthrough: it leads with “3 joining,” circles the BUSD result, asks “Ask me how?”, and calls it the power of the system. The title adds “Contact” and identifies an income-generating plan. The absence of spoken signup instructions does not erase the earnings-based solicitation in the text and image.

citations.quote: Forsage BUSD 💯% Income Generating Plan 😊 Contact #blockchain #forsage #mlm #networkmarketing

opening.argument: Judge, the title openly identifies this as network marketing and asks interested viewers to make contact. Referral-based business promotion is not established as a scam solely by that description. The frame shows a partner count and a claimed result, but supplies no required deposit, purchase price, compensation schedule, credential request, or instruction to recruit a downline. Those missing terms matter: the evidence may justify skepticism about the earnings claim, but it does not show the transaction or payment mechanism a viewer would actually face.

citations.quote: Forsage BUSD 💯% Income Generating Plan 😊 Contact #blockchain #forsage #mlm #networkmarketing

rebuttal.rebuttal: The prosecution connects joining, three partners, and the displayed BUSD figure. The frame does not separate sales proceeds, account totals, and recruitment payments, however, or specify who would pay whom. The call to ask how leaves the commercial terms undisclosed; it cannot establish a particular tiered payout structure on its own.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: A complete compensation schedule is unnecessary to see what this video promotes. Its headline attributes a large earnings figure to three joining, while the highlighted interface pairs three partners with a BUSD result and asks viewers how. The title explicitly pitches a Forsage income plan and invites contact. Missing transaction details limit what can be said about its mechanics, not whether the visible pitch ties income to recruitment.
